## SK Hynix and Samsung Each Fall Approximately 7% as Chip Selloff Spreads Across Asian Equities

Dual ~7% declines in both Korean memory giants with confirmed Asian spread is a contagion signal that historically precedes volatility expansion in US semiconductor names; the breadth of the move—multiple outlets, multiple markets—argues against a single-catalyst interpretation and warrants position-level review.

- SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics both declined approximately 7% in the session, confirmed across multiple outlets
- The selloff is explicitly described as extending and spreading across broader Asian equity markets
- Simultaneous declines of comparable magnitude in both Korean memory majors indicate systemic rather than company-specific pressure
- Regional contagion is confirmed, moving the narrative beyond Korea-only risk
